name: nuxt-modular-monorepo
description: Monorepo for nuxt-modular: turn a Nuxt app into an extensible host platform.
author: Nhữ Duy Thìn

scripts.dev: pnpm dev:prepare && pnpm --dir playground run dev
scripts.verify:ssr: pnpm dev:prepare && pnpm --dir playground run verify:ssr
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify:ssr
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm dev:prepare && pnpm --dir playground run test:e2e
